cohort: Very-low-birth-weight infants (VLBWIs) weighing less than 1500 g born between 2013 and 2017 in Korea
finding: Cesarean section was not associated with any significant reduction in mortality or morbidity in VLBWIs compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: While total mortality and sepsis were lower in the CS group, in specific gestational age groups (25-26 weeks for mortality, and 27-28 and 29-34 weeks for sepsis), these outcomes were significantly higher in the CS group compared to the VD group.
